resources.string: A hostname matches exactly. Use *.aihubmix.com or suffix:aihubmix.com to include all subdomains. keyword: and cidr: are also supported.
aihubmix.com matches only that domain. Subdomains such as api.aihubmix.com are excluded.
aihubmix.com matches the domain itself and every subdomain, including api.aihubmix.com and chat.api.aihubmix.com. You can also enter *.aihubmix.com or suffix:aihubmix.com.
aihubmix matches any domain containing that text.
Enter an IP address or a range such as 192.0.2.0/24.
